propositions: A persisted file_impact_scope value of 'none' must route the no-file-impact criterion into Pass-1 selection; other values (paths, undeclared, missing, None, unknown) must not.

The no-file-impact criterion must invoke an LLM only when the routing predicate matches, using deterministic `applies_at.require_file_impact_scope: ["none"]` to prevent spurious calls and cost leakage.

The declared no_file_impact_reason must round-trip through deterministic JSON-serialized structured context into the production Pass-1 LLM request, preserving quotes, newlines, and Unicode; a missing reason must serialize as an explicit empty string.

The criterion rubric must emit PASS for external-only deliverables, advisory contradiction findings for required repository-file changes (including documentation), and non-blocking insufficient coaching when evidence is too vague to establish the assertion's truth.

Tests must verify only observable public contracts (routing selection, LLM request payload, CLI explain output, advisory aggregation behavior) and not depend on source-text grep or private implementation shape; a defect-seeded routing-predicate mutation must fail a held-out applicability test.
